Three year (Six semesters) Degree Course in commerce:
There is a three-year course (Semester System) of stud for the degree of Bachelor of commerce (B.Com). It shall consist of Six Semesters (three years). There shall be two types of courses- A) Pass Course and B) Honours Course
Two year (four Semesters) Post Graduate Course in Commerce:
There is two-year course(Semester System) of study for the Post Graduate degree of Master of Commerce (M.Com). It shall consist of Four Semesters.
